task.instruction: Explain what a VPN is in two sentences

surface.reply: A VPN (virtual private network) creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and a server run by the VPN provider, so your internet traffic is protected from eavesdroppers on the network. It also hides your real IP address by routing your traffic through that server, which improves privacy and lets you appear to be browsing from a different location.
